name: luxcrypta-prompt-accelerator
description: Local-first continuity runtime for review, workflow reuse, carry-forward capsules, and desktop AI workflow persistence.

scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:desktop:renderer && npm run build:desktop:main
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:desktop:dir: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --dir --publish never
scripts.package:desktop:mac: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.package:desktop:mac:arm64: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:desktop:mac:x64: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:desktop:mac:unsigned: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --publish never -c.mac.identity=null
scripts.package:desktop:mac:unsigned:arm64: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=null
scripts.package:desktop:mac:unsigned:x64: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --x64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=null
scripts.package:desktop:win: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.package:desktop:win:arm64: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --win nsis portable --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:desktop:win:x64: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:desktop:linux: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage deb --publish never
scripts.package:desktop:linux:arm64: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage deb --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:desktop:linux:x64: npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:desktop:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:desktop
scripts.build:chromium: vite build --config apps/extension/vite.config.ts --mode chromium && node apps/extension/scripts/build.chromium.mjs
scripts.build:firefox: vite build --config apps/extension/vite.config.ts --mode firefox && node apps/extension/scripts/build.firefox.mjs
